reviews.title: Surprisingly nice
reviews.comment: I bought this for a build for my daughters. My main qualification was it needed to be cheap, but look nice. I was very surprised with his this case turned out. This was a great case to build in. There are some good channels for wire management and it fit a 315mm graphics card. I also appreciate the captive screws to open the case up. If you are putting a large card in this I might recommend checking out an SFX power supply. I managed to get mine to fit, but it took some creative placement of the cables since there is like 3/4 inch clearance
reviews.author: Mat Jones

reviews.title: Super cute, minor flaws
reviews.comment: Great small case for a budget pc. Pros: it’s cute my gf loves it. It’s also made very well, I love how strong it feels. Cons: it’s tight, cable management is almost impossible. Also it shows 6 fans ur lucky to get 4 realistically. Also u need a tiny PSU I ordered my go to corsair but even installed at the tallest bracket it would not work. Had to fight Amazon for a return and ended up buying the matching one from the same brand. Over all I give it a 4.5 for Minecraft gaming PCs.
reviews.author: Timothy J Steen

reviews.title: Extremely compact !
reviews.comment: Great case for the size. Fit was better than expected, I was able to install an RTX 3070 with no issues. For a compact case, the airflow is solid, though temps run slightly on the warmer side, which is expected. The build quality feels good and sturdy, and the appearance is clean and modern. It looks great on the desk without taking up much space. In terms of versatility, it handles larger components better than you’d think for a Micro-ATX/Mini-ITX case. Value for money is excellent considering what you can fit into it. Overall, a great compact case that balances size, performance, and looks. Definitely recommend.
reviews.author: Nick C

reviews.title: Great little case!
reviews.comment: I bought this to build a light gaming and steaming rig for my wife. It was tight as expected but not too bad. I think it turned out better than expected and I am very happy with the quality of the case.
reviews.author: jereme morton

reviews.title: Good value case with some problems.
reviews.comment: The quality of the case reflects its price. It's good value, but you get what you pay for. I wish there were included dust filters in the bottom of the case, but again, hard to ask for a ton at this price. The size of the case is decent. Fits mATX boards well. Some of the cables in the front panel were short and didn't reach very well. The included fan was fine. Didn't notice and excessive noise from running it. The case is kinda thin, so it's easy to bend when working on it. When it's put together it's sturdy enough. I did have some issues with the finish of the paint in some spots, but not a huge deal. Overall, if you're making a budget mATX build, this case will function admirably, but if you can spend a little more you'll probably enjoy the quality of life that can come with a better case.
reviews.author: Nicholas S.
